jobs_results.title: Arquitecto/a Salesforce
jobs_results.description:
SegurCaixa Adeslas es la compañía No Vida líder en España en seguros de salud, integrada en el Grupo Mutua Madrileña y participada por CaixaBank.

En los últimos años se ha convertido en una entidad de referencia gracias a la implantación de un modelo de negocio basado en el crecimiento sostenido y rentable, que sitúa al cliente en el centro de la estrategia. A través de su acuerdo de bancaseguros con CaixaBank, SegurCaixa Adeslas comercializa sus productos en la mayor red bancaria de España. Adicionalmente, la aseguradora cuenta con una red tradicional con más de 4.000 puntos de venta y atención al cliente.

Estamos convencid@s de que las personas son el principal valor de nuestra compañía y por eso SegurCaixa Adeslas se muestra absolutamente comprometida con la igualdad de oportunidades entre hombres y mujeres. Nuestro Plan de Igualdad persigue hacer efectivo este principio y por ello, el proceso de selección de nuestras ofertas garantiza la igualdad de oportunidades a todas las... candidaturas.

En la actualidad, estamos en plena transformación tecnológica y necesitamos reforzar el equipo de Digitalización de Clientes con un Responsable Técnico de Salesforce (perfil técnicamente potente)

REQUISITOS
• Experiencia demostrable como Responsable Técnico Salesforce en empresas y proyectos de gran tamaño.
• Conocimientos y experiencia metodología agile
• Se valorará conocimientos y experiencia trabajando con el modelo de datos de Salesforce e integraciones.
• Conocimientos avanzados de Salesforce.
• Certificaciones requeridas: Salesforce Technical Arquitect (application or system architect).
• VALORABLE: 5 certificaciones Salesforce (architect)

FUNCIONES
• Visión estratégica sobre los distintos proyectos Salesforce de SCA, manteniéndose al día de las novedades incorporadas en cada nueva reléase de fabricante.
• Garantiza diseño de soluciones para implantaciones Salesforce acorde con las best practices del fabricante y la propia arquitectura y estándares de SCA
• Garantiza la reutilización de soluciones. Aportando soluciones específicas a problemas complejos.
• Capacidad de identificar problemas de seguridad inherente a los desarrollos Salesforce y proponer soluciones.
• Ofrecer asesoramiento especializado a los responsables de los desarrollos Salesforce para asegurar la escalabilidad de la solución, reducir riesgos y corregir problemas de rendimiento.
• Liderar sesiones de Design authority en las que sea capaz de entender los diseños técnicos planteados por los diferentes proyectos/labs y validarlos o reencaminar hacia diseños alineados con la estrategia global de diseño, sostenibilidad de software y eficiencia de la plataforma, así como la convivencia con el resto de apps de la organización.
• Verificar el diseño del software mediante la construcción y aplicación de los métodos apropiados.
• Realizar un seguimiento proactivo del estado de los límites de la plataforma y procesos desarrollados por los proyectos.
• Liderar e impulsar las actividades necesarias para garantizar la estabilidad de la plataforma o una baja performance del software.
• Seguimiento de la monitorización de la plataforma en entorno productivo y sandboxes para detectar anomalías, incidencias o puntos de mejora.
• Apoyo a los diferentes proyectos de cada ámbito Salesforce para la consecución de los objetivos.

¿Eres tu la persona que estamos buscando? Envíanos tu Cv

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Service Desk Manager
jobs_results.description:
Joining MICROPOLE means joining an innovative agency that empowers brands and businesses. With a diverse team of talents, we tackle communication challenges head-on, from ecosystem deployment to e-commerce and beyond. Our international clients in luxury, outdoor, and financial sectors appreciate our unbridled creativity. 💼🚀

As the largest agency in French-speaking Switzerland, MICROPOLE offers a unique opportunity for growth and collaboration. Currently, we're seeking a Salesforce Service Desk Manager to join our team, with the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Spain. 🏖️

Responsibilities:
• Conduct daily operational point meetings to assess ongoing issues, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with service goals.
• Lead weekly backlog meetings to review outstanding tickets, prioritize based on urgency and impact, and allocate resources for timely resolution.
• Evaluate the performance of SalesForce RUN operations and identify areas for improvement.
• Take a pivotal... role in Endpoint Problem Management by identifying, analyzing, and resolving recurring technical issues.
• Participate in reviews of Problem Management to refine processes and prevent the recurrence of known issues.
• Collaborate with other leaders to align service desk operations with organizational goals.
• Contribute to the assessment and approval of proposed infrastructure changes.
• Represent the service desk's interests in meetings with our two main clients.
• Ensure all service management processes are efficient, effective, and continually improving.

Requirements:
• Proven experience as a Service Desk Manager or similar role.
• Strong knowledge of ITIL best practices.
• Excellent leadership and communication skills.
• Ability to prioritize tasks and allocate resources effectively.
• Analytical mindset with problem-solving abilities.
• Familiarity with ServiceNow and endpoint technologies.
• Experience in managing infrastructure changes and problem management.
• Excellent spoken and written English.
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

At MICROPOLE, we value not only your skills and experience but also your personality, interpersonal skills, and enthusiasm for contributing to our company culture. If your qualifications, growth mindset, and personality align with our vision, we're excited to welcome you on board!

Don't hesitate to join us: https://www.micropole.com

jobs_results.description:
Description

Desde Grupo Digital, buscamos para importante cliiente internacional de sector Banca

Salesforce DevOps Release Manager

Design, Implement and oversee the DevOps strategy for the project. This includes but is not limited to the

CI/CD workflow (Version Control, and automated deployments)

Sandbox Management

Documenting releases

Overseeing the Developer Workflow and ensuring Code Reviews take place.

Work closely with QA, Tech Leads, Senior Devs and Architects to ensure the smooth delivery of build artefacts into Salesforce environments.

Implement scripts utilising the Salesforce Metadata API and SFDX

Refine technical user stories as required, articulate clearly the technical solution required to meet a specific requirement.

Support the Tech Lead with ensuring best practises are adhered to, providing mentorship and code review feedback as required.

Work with Tech Leads to author Technical Design Documents, ensuring adherence to design patterns.

Ownership of the... development workflow for the development team and ability to guide and effectively communicate the workflow to Development teams

Knowledge in Salesforce Development

Excellent technical documentation skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM is a Merkle & Dentsu company, leader in development of Customer Experience services, with +20 years of experience in the use of Technology applied to Marketing and providing a unique Customer Relationship with mainly focus on Innovation is looking for a Technical Lead.

MAIN TASKS:
• Provide support to the sales and functional team in assigned accounts when technical knowledge of the solution is required: Solution design, estimation, and assumptions.
• Support the PM/DM in technical leadership on the project, bringing comprehensive technical knowledge of the platform and identifying the best solution to meet the project's functional demands.
• Detect and notify risks in the technical management of project/client profitability.
• Ensure the smooth progress of the project in terms of Scope, Schedule, and Costs. Alerting and anticipating possible deviations to the Project Manager/Delivery Manager.
• Ensure the fulfillment of the project's technical objectives.
• Ensure... compliance with the agreed software quality standards with Omega's Technical Management.
• Supervise the effort estimations of the development and support team during the testing phase of a project.
• Collaborate with the PM/DM in project demos for the client.
• Ensure the final delivery of technical documentation for a project.
• Participate in the development and training of the technical team, advising them to improve their technical skills.
• Identify possible technical Up & Cross Selling opportunities.
• Identify possible methodological improvements for the technical team.
• Collaborate in Omega's community of practice, providing thought leadership, training, and mentoring to other collaborators to develop technical capabilities.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
• 3+ years participating in the full lifecycle of Salesforce.com implementations.
• Experience in Salesforce.com projects.
• Experience in the different modules: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud,
• Experience with agile methodologies.
• High level of English.

What Do We Offer
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office. You decide and we support you.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurtant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention
• Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go.

About Us

Our mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, , #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 500 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

jobs_results.title: Salesforce QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
At Omega CRM we believe that the quality of the project we develop is very important. Therefore, we would like for our QA team to keep growing:

Duties & Responsibilities

As a member of the QA team that we currently have in Omega, the main responsibilities in your day to day may be the following:
• Creation of test cases based on the analysis of documentation or business requirements, defining the results precisely without entering into ambiguities.
• Execution of test cases based on their design with a degree of quality and efficiency.
• Reporting errors by attaching all information clearly so that the developer has no doubts when resolving them.
• Basic knowledge in software development.
• Generating a progress report of tasks or areas of responsibility.
• Mastery of the use of established QA tools for the project/service.

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Project Manager - Product Owner
jobs_results.description:
Salesforce Project Manager - Product Owner

Neurored helps global businesses digitize their operations in the fast-paced world of Trade, Transportation, and Logistics; Neurored has developed the leading Transportation Management System (TMS) Software on Salesforce applications on the Salesforce AppExchange, becoming a reference partner of Salesforce worldwide

Sector: Technology

We have the need to incorporate talent to help us scale our operations. Our objective is to incorporate a Salesforce expert, with a Project Management profile who has experience in Logistics processes and systems, and who knows how to design processes to support projects with their clients

We are looking for a proactive profile, problem solver, results-oriented and with a focus on business analysis. If you have experience in the world of consulting, have studied a technical career (engineering or related field), are bilingual in English, manage advance Salesforce environment and are familiar with agile... methodologies, this challenge is perfect for you!

Responsibilities:

• Coordination and leadership of solution sales processes

• Customer relationship management

• Manage advance Salesforce environment

• Direct and supervise international systems implementation projects using agile methodologies to ensure efficient and high-quality delivery

• Software Systems Consultant / Product Owner

• Scrum meeting planning

• Listening skills. Understanding customer requirements

• Gap analysis compared to our software solutions

• Understand and resolve problems (customer/internal) with processed data/software effectively and efficiently

• Delivery Management, structuring the phases and processes of a software project under agile methodologies

• Planning and execution of solution demonstrations

• Capacity for teamwork and team development

• Ability to translate business needs to the technology team

• English spoken, read, and written

• Functional skills, aptitude and problem-solving character are highly valued

Essential capabilities:

• University degree in engineering or related field

• 3-5 years experience in business or systems consulting in one of the large consulting firms

• Expert in the Salesforce environment

• Solid knowledge of agile methodologies and ability to implement them

• Experience in Business Analytics

• Bilingual English (spoken and written)

• International experience in project management

• Ability to effectively solve problems and make informed decisions

• Entrepreneurial and proactive attitude

• Ability to approach challenges with confidence and determination

• Experience with complex projects

• Ability to adapt to international schedules and multicultural environments

• Listening ability. Understanding and gathering customer requirements

Valuable capabilities:

• Other languages besides English

• Global Trade, Transportation, and Logistics Sector knowledge

Sector

• Transportation, logistics, supply chain and storage

Job type

• Full time
